newsitem.title: USA: Isidore emerges as 9th tropical storm in Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: Isidore emerges as 9th tropical storm in Atlantic.

text.p: Tropical Storm Isidore was born early Wednesday, becoming the ninth tropical storm of the Atlantic hurricane season, the National Hurricane Center said.
Isidore was located far from land at latitude 10.4 north and longitude 29.2 west, or about 500 miles (805 km) southwest of Africa's Cape Verde islands.

At 0500 EDT/0900 GMT, Isidore was upgraded from a tropical depression to a tropical storm with maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (65 kmh), forecasters said. Further strengthening was expected as Isidore moved west-northwest at 20 mph (32 kmh), they added.
